sections.skill: Interpret the parameters of a linear or exponential function in context

questions.skill: Interpret the parameters of a linear or exponential function in context
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: C(m) = 0.35m + 40 is the cost in dollars of renting a car for one day and driving m miles. What do 0.35 and 40 mean?
questions.prompt_markup:
C(m) = 0.35m + 40 is the cost in dollars of renting a car for one day and driving m miles.
What do 0.35 and 40 mean?
questions.correct_answer: 0.35: the cost per mile ($0.35); 40: the daily fee ($40) charged even for 0 miles.
questions.grading_note: Form required: both meanings.

questions.skill: Interpret the parameters of a linear or exponential function in context
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: P(t) = 1,200(1.04)^t is a town's population t years after 2020. What do 1,200 and 1.04 mean?
questions.prompt_markup:
P(t) = 1,200(1.04)^t is a town's population t years after 2020.
What do 1,200 and 1.04 mean?
questions.correct_answer: 1,200: the population in 2020; 1.04: the population grows 4% each year.
questions.grading_note: Form required: both meanings.

questions.skill: Interpret the parameters of a linear or exponential function in context

questions.prompt: A(t) = 80(0.5)^(t/6) is the milligrams of a medicine left in the body after t hours. What do 80, 0.5, and 6 mean?
questions.prompt_markup:
A(t) = 80(0.5)^(t/6) is the milligrams of a medicine left in the body after t hours.
What do 80, 0.5, and 6 mean?
questions.correct_answer: 80 mg is the starting dose; half of the medicine remains after every 6 hours (a half-life of 6 hours).
questions.grading_note: Form required: all three meanings.

questions.prompt: V(t) = 18,000 - 1,500t is a machine's value in dollars after t years. What does -1,500 mean?
questions.prompt_markup:
V(t) = 18,000 - 1,500t is a machine's value in dollars after t years.
What does -1,500 mean?

choices.text: The machine loses $1,500 of value each year.
The machine loses 1,500% of its value each year.
The machine is worth $18,000 after 1,500 years.

questions.grading_note: The slope is the change in value per year.

questions.nearest_connection: Interpreting the parameters of a function in context leads to interpreting the parameters of a normal model.

questions.prompt: Battery life is normal with mean 400 hours and standard deviation 20 hours. What does the 20 tell you?
questions.prompt_markup:
Battery life is normal with mean 400 hours and standard deviation 20 hours.
What does the 20 tell you?
questions.correct_answer: It measures spread: battery lives typically differ from the mean by roughly 20 hours (about 68% are within 20 hours of 400).
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent description of the standard deviation as a typical (root-mean-square) distance from the mean.
